note: docs/plans/2026-10-08-timbre-prism-in-aspect.md §4 in a StackPanel; the sound and the Prism layer are animated in two @on MouseEnter blocks because one Motion execution cannot mix Timbre and Prism targets and an @on holds one execution.
markup: <StackPanel><StackPanel.Resources><TimbreClip Name="UiSounds">@parameter Brightness: float = 1200; @sound Click { Source = "audio/click.wav"; } @sound Hover { Source = "audio/hover.wav"; Volume = 0.3; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Brightness; } }</TimbreClip><PrismClip Name="CardFx">@parameter GlowRadius: float = 18; @layer Foreground { @filter Blur { Radius = GlowRadius; } }</PrismClip><Aspect Name="MenuButton" TargetType="Button">@timbre $UiSounds(Brightness = 800); @prism $CardFx(GlowRadius = 24); @on Click { @play $self.timbre.Click; } @on MouseEnter { @play $self.timbre.Hover; @animate with Tween(300ms, EaseOut) { @to { $self.timbre.Hover.Volume = 0.8; } } } @on MouseEnter { @animate with Tween(300ms, EaseOut) { @to { $self.prism.Foreground.Opacity = 0.5; } } } @on MouseLeave { @stop $self.timbre.Hover; }</Aspect></StackPanel.Resources><Border Name="Speaker"><Border.Aspect>@timbre { @sound Music { Source = "audio/music.ogg"; Loop = true; Volume = 0.4; AutoPlay = true; } }</Border.Aspect></Border><Button Content="Start" Aspect="$MenuButton" /><Button Content="Music"><Button.Aspect>@on Click { @pause $Speaker.timbre.Music; }</Button.Aspect></Button></StackPanel>

<Border><Border.Aspect>@timbre { @sound Music { Source = "audio/music.ogg"; Loop = true; AutoPlay = true; } } @on MouseEnter { @pause $self.timbre.Music; } @on MouseLeave { @resume $self.timbre.Music; } @on MouseDown { @seek $self.timbre.Music to 30s; } @on MouseUp { @stop $self.timbre.Music; @play $self.timbre.Music; }</Border.Aspect></Border>

<StackPanel><StackPanel.Resources><TimbreClip Name="Sounds">@sound Click { Source = "audio/click.wav"; }</TimbreClip><Aspect Name="Clicky" TargetType="Button">@timbre $Sounds; @on Click { @play $self.timbre.Click; }</Aspect></StackPanel.Resources><Button Content="A" Aspect="$Clicky" /><Button Content="B" Aspect="$Clicky" /></StackPanel>

<Button Content="Sweep"><Button.Aspect>@timbre { @parameter Brightness: float = 4000; @sound Hover { Source = "audio/hover.wav"; @modifier LowPass { Cutoff = Brightness; } } } @on Click { @play $self.timbre.Hover; @animate with Tween(300ms, Linear) { @to { $self.timbre.Hover.Brightness = 200; } } }</Button.Aspect></Button>

<StackPanel><CheckBox Name="PlayBox" Content="Play" /><Border Name="Speaker"><Border.Aspect>@timbre { @sound Music { Source = "audio/music.ogg"; Loop = true; } } @when $PlayBox.IsChecked { @if $PlayBox.IsChecked == true { @play $self.timbre.Music; } @if $PlayBox.IsChecked == false { @stop $self.timbre.Music; } }</Border.Aspect></Border></StackPanel>
